DeployBot: scheduled rollout CR-2026-0819: API v2 staged tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC. plan: EU -> US -> APAC. canary 1% -> 5% -> 25%. assignees: @Maya R @Jason H. ops playbook: https://intra/redwood/releases/CR-2026-0819
Maya R: note: several older SDKs may omit new `system_messages` array. we should identify top tenants and consider a short soft-pin to v1 for them.
Jason H: Kira, run header/audit query: `./tools/query_clients --since=14d --filter "api_version!=v2 or header_missing"`
Kira L: quick output: ~27 tenants with persistent non-v2 traffic. top 3: papertrail, marketly, spinup. I can stage a header-fallback for missing headers: `route_header_fallback: {"X-API-VERSION":"v1"}` for 6h.
Sam (SDK): pushing a 1.0.x compat patch to handle missing `system_messages` gracefully. ETA: 90m for PR + patch release.
DeployBot: canary started 01:10 UTC -> routing=1% (eu-west). telemetry hooks: /ops/telemetry/CR-2026-0819.
DeployBot: ALERT: client crash spike detected from mobile SDKs (rate +0.4%). alert=A-CR-2026-02
Maya R: pause ramp. @Jason H freeze routing at 1%.
Jason H: `routingctl set-split CR-2026-0819 1%` -> done.
Kira L: logs show SDK 1.0 hit TypeError on `system_messages[0]` access for requests missing field. affected tenants match Kira's list.
Maya R: decision: rollback. criteria met (client crash + 5xx delta). Jason please initiate rollback and mark change rolled-back.
Jason H: `deploybot rollback CR-2026-0819 --reason "client parsing crashes"` -> running.
DeployBot: rollback complete 01:22 UTC. routing restored to 100% v1. CR-2026-0819 marked rolled-back. incident: https://intra/redwood/incidents/CR-2026-0819-followup
Maya R: action items: 1) Sam to ship SDK compat patch and publish release notes, 2) Kira to prepare targeted tenant comms and soft-pin list, 3) Jason to craft a guarded relaunch plan with 0.5% canary and extended client soft-pin.
Sam (SDK): PR opened, will request an expedited release.
Nate - oncall: I'll monitor crash telemetry for 24h and stand by for relaunch.
Maya R: closing thread. postmortem WIP: https://intra/redwood/releases/CR-2026-0819-postmortem :thumbsup:
